Description: SWE-bench Verified evaluates software engineering by asking a model to produce patches that fix real issues in open-source Python repositories. Cognitive Functions:

L2: Planning, Logical Reasoning, Working Memory
L3: Cognitive Flexibility, Self-reflection (minor), Inhibitory Control (minor)
